title: Release train huddle scratchpad
content:
Release Train Weekly Huddle — scratchpad
Date (prep): 2026-03-12
Meeting slot: Thu 09:30 PT (standup huddle)
Owner (running this): Maya Chen
Goal for this week: sanity-check deploy readiness for v2026.03 -> align blockers, validate test coverage, confirm monitoring, call launch decision by Friday EOD.

Quick status snapshot (one-line each):
- Infra / capacity: amber — GPUs for dedicated pools reserved but speculative burst config still WIP (infra-ops).
- Serving runtime: green — nightly perf regressions passed but one flaky test in attention-kernel on A100.
- Product flags / gating: amber — rollout gating rule missing final QA signoff for feature flag ENABLE_PROMPTS_V2.
- QA / e2e: red/amber — flaky test suite on long-seq tests, running extended nightly coverage; must pass smoke before canary.
- Observability / alerts: green — dashboards live, synthetic traffic set, paging test scheduled.
- Legal / compliance: green — final privacy blurb updated; no new blockers.

Attendees (expected): Maya, Evan, Sofia, Liam, Priya (QA lead), Daren (Infra), Anika (SRE on-call), Product PM (TBD)

Pre-meeting asks (what I want folks to drop into this doc before Thu):
- Infra: exact ETA for burst config + PR link
- QA: list of failing tests (names + flakiness %), ETA for smoke pass
- SRE: confirmation of runbook and pagers for canary window
- Product: final list of feature flags toggled for launch window
- Security: confirm audit trail for private deployment customers

Agenda (15-20m quick huddle):
1) Quick one-line status from each lane (infra, runtime, product, qa, docs, observability) — 7m
2) Blockers and mitigation plan (what needs owner + ETA) — 6m
3) Launch decision inputs for Friday: what still needs green check to proceed to canary — 5m
4) Assign action items and confirm communication plan for Friday decision — 2m

Checklist notes (working, not final):
- [ ] Infra capacity: burst config PR merged (owner: Daren) — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/221 — ETA: 2026-03-13 16:00 PT (amber)
- [x] Model artifact signed and pinned to manifest v2026.03 (owner: Evan) — commit: a7f4b2c
- [ ] DB migration dry-run complete on staging (owner: Sofia) — ticket JIRA-RT-512 — ETA: 2026-03-13 10:00 PT (blocked on staging snapshot)
- [ ] QA smoke on long-seq scenarios passed in staging (owner: Priya) — fail count: 3/42 flaky tests, running focused runs overnight (red)
- [ ] Canary policy config in console (owner: Liam) — need explicit traffic ramp-up percentages and health-check thresholds added before canary start (amber)
- [x] Docs: release notes draft uploaded to Confluence (owner: Maya) — CONFLUENCE-RT-46
- [ ] Observability: synthetic traffic for auth and chat paths created and alert thresholds set (owner: Anika) — test alert sent 2026-03-12 18:30 PT (pending verify)
- [ ] Feature flag matrix reviewed and approved (owner: Product PM) — flags: ENABLE_PROMPTS_V2 (partial rollout), FALLBACK_TO_SMALLER_MODEL (on)
- [ ] Security: KMS key rotation window validated (owner: Security) — scheduled 2026-03-15 out-of-band

Risks / notes:
- If any of the 3 long-seq QA flakes remain after tonight's run, block canary. Root cause likely memory fragmentation in the A100 kernel path; related PR 887 addresses but not merged.
- Burst infra misconfig can lead to cold-start latency regression under peak traffic (affects SLO 99th p95). Consider limiting initial canary qps.
- Rollback story: last-known-good is v2026.02 with pinned artifact a3c9f4e. Rolling back requires DB migration rollback script (Sofia) — need rehearsed plan before Friday.

Decision rubric (for Friday):
- Green = all critical blockers cleared (infra capacity, QA smoke, canary policy, runbooks)
- Amber = one non-blocking risk with mitigation plan and owner (e.g., infra burst delayed but safety cap set)
- Red = any open QA/DB migration/severe performance regressions

Tentative timeline (this week):
- Thu morning: last pre-check huddle (this doc updated by lanes)
- Thu EOD: freeze on any non-critical merges to release branch
- Fri AM: final go/hold assessment (as per rubric)
- Fri 14:00 PT: start canary (if green) with 10% traffic for 30m, increase to 30% for next 60m if healthy
- Fri evening: decision on full rollout or extended canary

Action items (short):
- Daren: merge burst infra PR + confirm autoscaler policy; due 2026-03-13 16:00 PT (linked: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/221)
- Priya: stabilize long-seq tests; provide failing test artifacts and stack traces; due 2026-03-13 12:00 PT
- Sofia: complete DB migration dry-run and produce rollback script notes; due 2026-03-13 11:00 PT (JIRA-RT-512)
- Liam: finalize canary ramp config in Console and attach health thresholds; due 2026-03-13 15:00 PT
- Anika: run pager end-to-end test for canary alerting and add runbook link; due 2026-03-13 14:30 PT
- Evan: ensure model artifact checksum published and update manifest; done
- Product PM: confirm feature flag decision for ENABLE_PROMPTS_V2 and send final list to on-call; due 2026-03-13 13:00 PT

Follow-ups for next huddle:
- Re-check status of action items, escalate any missed ETAs in #release-coordinator
- If amber condition persists on infra, prepare contingency to limit canary to internal traffic only
- Run one simulated rollback on staging to validate rollback script (Sofia + Daren)

Random notes / scratch thoughts:
- Consider running a short perf-under-load test with synthetic prompts of 2k tokens to validate sequence path. Might catch the long-seq flakes earlier.
- If QA flakes are memory-related, try reproducing with smaller batch sizes to identify threshold.
- Keep customer comms minimal until canary stable; pre-write short blurb for status page in case of delay.

References / links to drop in here before Thu:
- Staging snapshot link: (add)
- QA run logs: (link to artifact once Priya uploads)
- Infra PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/221
- Runtime kernel PR addressing seq fragmentation: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/887

Notes to self:
- If Friday becomes amber, escalate to execs only if public-facing SLAs at risk; otherwise schedule extended canary Monday morning.
- Keep this doc as canonical pre-meeting scratchpad; after Thu update, move important items into Confluence checklist for audit.

End of scratchpad.
